about: Funcheap SF (sf.funcheap.com): hand-picked free and cheap San Francisco Bay Area events. This CLI lists events by date, today or weekend, category, region or neighborhood, venue and recurring series, and fetches event details. Each result has title, date/time, cost, venue and URL.

commands.summary: List events happening on a specific calendar date (WordPress date archive). The details field holds date, time, cost and venue text.
List upcoming events in a region or neighborhood, e.g. san-francisco, east-bay, peninsula, south-bay, north-bay, soma-san-francisco. Paginated.

params.name: region
params.description: Region or neighborhood slug as in /region/{slug}/, e.g. soma-san-francisco, mission-san-francisco, san-francisco, east-bay, peninsula, south-bay, north-bay

params.name: page
params.description: Result page number (10 events per page)

commands.summary: List upcoming events in an event-type category such as live music, comedy, eating & drinking, art & museums or movies. Paginated.

params.name: category
params.description: Event-type category slug, e.g. live-music-event, comedy-event-types-event, eating-drinking, art-museums, movies

params.name: page
params.description: Result page number (10 events per page)

commands.summary: List events happening today in San Francisco and the Bay Area.
List events for this weekend. Pass --next 1 for the following weekend.

params.name: next
params.description: Set to 1 to get next weekend instead of this weekend

commands.summary: List upcoming free events in San Francisco and the Bay Area.
List the editors' *Top Pick* events of the week.
Day-by-day calendar of upcoming events for a calendar region (san-francisco, east-bay). Rows without a url are date headings. Paginated.
Get an event's detail page metadata (name, description, URL, image) by its slug, the path segment of an event url.

params.name: slug
params.description: Event slug from a listing url, e.g. https://sf.funcheap.com/{slug}/

commands.summary: List upcoming events at a venue, by venue slug (from /venue/{slug}/ links).
List all upcoming dates of a recurring event series, by series slug (from /event-series/{slug}/ links).
RSS feed of recently added events, site-wide only (per-region feeds redirect here), with title, link, publish date and categories.
